title: Trust Regions, Natural Gradients, TRPO, PPO
author: Lain Mustafaoglu
summary: Notes on trust region methods: from Newton's method and its failure modes, through line search and trust regions, the KL geometry of policy space, the Fisher matrix and natural gradient, to TRPO and PPO.

title: Rosenbrock Explorer
summary: An interactive visualization of the Rosenbrock function — drag a point around the contour plot to compare gradient descent and Newton's method in real time.
